svg.title: hermes-claude-sdk — Hermes plans, Claude codes
svg.desc: A Hermes agent on one machine starts, steers and inspects real Claude Code runs on a Mac. The Hermes host holds a plugin that provides seven tools and uses the standard library only; it sends one JSON envelope over ssh, or over a local transport when Hermes runs on the same Mac. The Mac runs a LaunchAgent that drives Claude Code inside a git worktree.
